Use @Image1 as the starting frame.
Steady handheld drift forward following @Image2. A gentle wave breaks near her, white spray misting her legs and the hem of her shirt. She lowers her raised hand, dips both hands into the shallow water, then runs cool wet fingers back through her hair, droplets flying as she stands upright smiling into the salt air.
Shirt and hair flutter in the breeze. Ocean waves continue rolling in with soft foam wash around her bare feet.

gentle ocean waves, soft breeze, distant shorebirds. wave breaking with light spray, water splash as hands dip, wet fingers through hair, soft water wash around bare feet.

No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds. Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
